rationale_overall: NVDA remains the single strongest sole exposure to the AI wave, and the profile calls for riding until a crest, not trimming early. Pass-1 across every named wave surfaced future candidates (IONQ, NuScale, Intuitive Machines) but none remotely comparable in magnitude to NVDA's Q4 beat plus GTC reveal, and at cap=1 a swap means abandoning the strongest signal. No breach or peak signal. Hold NVDA.
